player_prompt.intro:
Udlala Mastermind.
Kufuneka ufumane ikodi eyona ibizwa ngayo {code_length} idijithi, eyona nombolo kwi-1 hada {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Kwimphendulo yakho, ungakwazi ukunika uthando lwakho ngendlela leyi: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Emva kwenye uthando lwakho, uzakufumana ukutshintshwa ngokuthandwa kwezinto ezimnyama nezimhlophe.
Iphiko lezinto ezimnyama liphinda inombolo eyikweli kwiindawo ezikweli, iphiko lezinto ezimhlophe liphinda inombolo eyikweli kwiindawo ezingekweli.
Unayo {max_turns} izichumo zokunika ikodi.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Awuphendulanga ngoludwe lweenombolo ezahlulwe ngesithuba ezifakwe phakathi kweekhonkco.
invalid_move.not_integers: Zonke iingeniso kufuneka zibe ziinombolo ezipheleleyo ezisemthethweni.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Onke amanani kufuneka abe phakathi ko-1 no-{num_numbers}.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Sele uqikelele {guess}. Nceda uzame ukuqikelela ngenye indlela.

game_action.feedback: Submitted [{guess}]. Feedback: {black_pegs} black peg(s), {white_pegs} white peg(s).

outcome.win: You have cracked the code, solving {black_pegs} out of {code_length} pegs correctly
outcome.turn_limit: Umda wokuguqula ufikelelwe. Uqikelele {percent} ekhulwini lamanani ngokuchanekileyo.
